pour: Mac with 24 to 32 GB (24 GB: M2, M3, M4, M4 Pro): Ternary Bonsai 2 27B in 2 bits, one conversation, 32,768-token window; conservative default, not measured under PLI

conditions.effet: 32 GB or more: DFlash2 drafter (it requires about 20 GiB of budget, ternary-bonsai-2.md recipe)
conditions.sinon: less than 32 GB: no drafter (with it you need about 20 GiB of budget)

memoire.detail: Bonsai 2 27B: 2-bit codes 7.2 GiB, 13.9 GiB expanded to 4 bits on M1 to M4 when budget allows; default budget 70% of memory (16.8 GiB on 24 GB), including 3 GiB outside allocator (RUNBOOK); TensorFold measurements, not PLI
memoire.si_trop_petit: Under 24 GB, PLI has no measured or estimated model that fits: the smallest family is a 27B. Use another engine for a small model.
